description: The fat-controller case of NS-01 section 4c, in DDD form. The purchase limit (no more than 20 units of one SKU per order) is checked only in OrderController.create. Neither PlaceOrderService nor the Order aggregate checks it, so any other entry point (a queue consumer, a batch import) creates orders that break the invariant. The aggregate should guard it.

misplacedResponsibilities.responsibility: Enforces the purchase limit (at most 20 units of one SKU per order), a business invariant of the Order aggregate.

cheapExpectation.why: Observed in the zero-call mock dry run on 2026-10-18, before any model run: the cheap role proxy flags OrderController (logic in a controller). Its twin's controller (case-06t) is not flagged. So on this pair a deterministic heuristic already separates defect from twin: NS-01 section 7 falsifier 1 applies, and this pair cannot by itself support a claim that a model is needed. It stays in the set because it is the canonical K3 case of NS-01 section 4c.
